summary: 26North BDC, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary 26N DL Funding 1 LLC, as borrower, entered into Amendment No. 5 to its Loan and Security Agreement dated October 18, 2023, with JPMorgan Chase as administrative agent. The amendment extends the scheduled termination date to October 9, 2031, resets interest to an applicable reference rate (SOFR, SONIA, SARON, EURIBOR or CORRA) plus 2.00%, sets a 55% advance rate (step-up to 57.5%/60% subject to conditions), cuts the commitment fee to 0.70%, and lowers the ARR concentration limit to 15%. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation.
